tests.name: large and small lifecycle advances agree
art gate precedes event and funds
tank sequencing and level gates apply to either currency
tank purchases reject unsupported currencies without charging
empty water startles nearby coin and pearl fish without changing care or rewards
water taps keep the current heading on either side of the fish
water taps stay bounded and clear on tank changes and transient reset
startled fish respect tank edges, selection, feeding and reduced motion
one pellet feeds exactly one fish after its notice delay
full tank accepts fish actions and preserves lower positions in saves
food and eggs settle 48 units above the tank bottom
fish swim and eat in the lower tank
food is bounded and cleared on tank switch
deferred gifts and egg rewards preserve state and enforce source unlocks
save round-trip, unknown IDs, duplicate IDs and future schemas
atomic storage retains corrupt primary and recovers backup
